How the numbers work

Every number is how many resources you would get right now, counting what is typed in the box and the other two choices. A greyed-out choice means nothing carries all of it — papers are filed whole, so an exam is rarely named together with a chapter. Exam filters match a file's own name only; type the exam in the box instead to also see related folders.

If the folder opens but a file will not, first check which Google account you are signed in with — tap your photo at the top right and switch. If it still will not open, use Spot a problem below and say which file. Everything is view-only; nothing can be broken.

They get named, filed into the right chapter, and credited to you.Open the drop folder → Tell a colleagueOne tap sends this page to anyone on WhatsApp. That is how the library reached a thousand teachers.Share on WhatsApp → Spot a problemA wrong name, a broken file, something that should not be here. Questions

How do I download a file?

Open it, then look top-right for the downward arrow. On a phone, tap the three dots and choose Download. A warning that the file cannot be scanned for viruses only means it is large — choose Download anyway.

Can I use this with my students?

Yes — that is the whole point. Teach from it, set it as homework, print pages for your class. Nobody should rebuild what another teacher already has. The one line to respect: many of these are commercially published books, so use them to teach, and do not re-upload or sell them.

Can I share it with other teachers?

Send them this page — the Share button does it in one tap. Please do not post the files themselves on a public website or a paid channel; most are commercially published books, and a library that spreads publicly gets taken down.

How do I keep it in my own Drive?

Open the main folder, tap its name at the top, choose Organise, then Add shortcut to Drive. It then sits in your Drive and updates as material is added.

Some files say NEEDS IDENTIFYING. Why?

Scans with no title page and no text inside. Rather than guess a title and mislead you, they carry an honest warning. Recognise one? Tell Indrajeet and it gets named.

Is anything personal in here?

No. Every folder was checked before it opened and swept again afterwards. No student records, marks, staff lists or contact files. Spot something that should not be here? Say so and it goes the same hour.
